title: Reviewers who rated above movie average
statementMd:
Count, per reviewer, how many of their reviews were above the average rating of the movie they reviewed. Show reviewers with at least 2 such reviews, ordered by count desc then name.

Expected columns: `reviewer`, `above`.

Tables: `directors`, `movies`, `reviews`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Correlated subquery for the movie average.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT r.reviewer, COUNT(*) AS above FROM reviews r WHERE r.rating > (SELECT AVG(r2.rating) FROM reviews r2 WHERE r2.movie_id = r.movie_id) GROUP BY r.reviewer HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY above DESC, r.reviewer;
```
